title: Good Ziplock bag organizer w/cutters to hang on wall or put in super large drawer but....
text:
Good Ziplock bag organizer w/cutters to hang on wall or put in super large drawer but..... I've reviewed and tried many of these organizers and I am both pleased and disappointed at the same time. I am pleased because this is an attractive black and gold six-compartment organizer with two compartments for a roll of foil and another wrap like waxed paper or plastic wrap. It also contains two cutters (already installed) that cut well. The four other compartments are for different types of Ziplock bags (quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack). However, what I do not like is the shoddy workmanship of excess glue globs on the interior (see photo) and a paint chip in the bonus tool supplied. I also HATE that there is this bonus tool provided without any explanation (either in the box or currently on the Amazon site) as to what it is for or how to use it. It is a spring-loaded piece of garbage to me.

This unit does not open, so the bags have to be loaded through their slots, which is perfect for when it is hung on the wall. The rolls also have to be threaded through the holes on their right side, so make sure there's enough room to do that installation without taking it off the wall for reloading. If the unit opened, the bags and rolls would fall out when filling this, so to me this is a plus.

Three screws with plastic mollies are provided for hanging. Also six rubberized circles are for the bottom to prevent the bamboo from scratching a wall or drawer and keep it from sliding around in a drawer.

Overall, this is a functional organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. I love the design but hate the glue globs and missing paint on the tool. I also hate that they supply a tool that I have to throw in the garbage because I have no idea what it is for. The current price of $59.99 is more than this [[ASIN:B0BFK5FSJQ version]] can be purchased for and which I like better for the reasons above.
